Amazon (AMZN) Faces New Rules After Court Lets Perplexity AI Shop Its Platform
items.summary: A U.S. appeals court has overturned a previous ruling and allowed Perplexity to use its AI shopping tools on Amazon's platform. This is the first federal appellate decision on how AI agents may access and operate on major online marketplaces. The ruling affects Amazon.com's control over third party tools on its marketplace and may influence future platform policies. items.title: AMD Stock Slides After Solid  Earnings Report
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported solid but unspectacular second-quarter earnings results on Tuesday afternoon.  Adjusted operating income reached $3.1 billion, with a 27% operating margin, just above the Wall Street consensus estimate.  In the all-important data center segment, sales were $6.7 billion, ahead of projections of $6.3 billion and up 107%, with a 31% operating margin.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 Hit New Highs; SpaceX Jumps Ahead Of Q2 Report
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 finished at record highs Tuesday, aided by slumping oil prices on fresh enthusiasm for a U.S.-Iran peace deal.  On the stock market today, Palantir Technologies zoomed up and Dell Technologies broke out of a base.  Space Exploration Technologies, known as SpaceX, surged before its quarterly report.
